text: Just completed my second lot of dental implants with Dr. Preecha and his team.  As usual he was very professional demanding high standards from his technicians and staff.  His prices are fair and I will be back should I have further needs. Highly recommended!

Went there to have loose implant done, price went from 2800 baht, to 38000 baht because they couldn't  fix it and said the implant had to be redone. Very unprofessional  and I do not recommend,  just a money grab. To all tourists and falang I suggest look elsewhere . BEWARE.

Dr Preecha and the rest of his team cleaned my teeth.  It had been a long time since I had this done so there was plenty of cleaning and de-scaling to be done.  I was very pleased with the result and would recommend this dentist who does a professional and gentle job and speaks excellent English so communication is easy.
